author: Patrick Cc:
description:
Tobey Maguire built his image as the shy nice guy in Hollywood.. but maybe he was trying to prevent his dark secrets from coming to light. From his early ties to Hollywood’s wildest inner circles to lawsuits, secret poker games, and a carefully managed public image, the Spider Man star may not be who fans thought he was.
